user.title: Link your hub
user.description:
Home Assistant signs in to your Thalovant account with a one-time code, then connects to the hub you choose. The link is an outgoing connection: there is no port to open, and no Home Assistant token leaves your home.

Select **Submit** to get a code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The link to {name} stopped working. Select **Submit** to renew it. If Thalovant asks you to sign in, use the same account as before.

hub.title: Choose a hub
hub.description: Signed in as {account}. Devices on the hub you choose will be able to control what you have exposed to Assist.

data_description.hub_id: Requests from this hub's devices will reach this Home Assistant. You can link more hubs later.

progress.wait_for_admission: Your hub {hub} is admitting Home Assistant. This usually takes about a minute and a half.
progress.wait_for_login:
Open {url} and approve the sign-in. If you are asked for a code, enter:

```
{code}
```

This step moves on by itself once you approve.

error.admission_failed: The hub did not admit Home Assistant. Try again in a few minutes.
error.admission_timeout: The hub took too long to admit Home Assistant, or Thalovant stopped answering. Try again in a few minutes.
error.already_linked: Another Home Assistant is already linked to this hub on your account. Remove that link in the Thalovant dashboard, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Thalovant. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.connection_refused: Thalovant refused to create the connection. Try again later.
error.hub_cannot_link: This hub cannot link Home Assistant yet.
error.invalid_auth: Thalovant did not accept the sign-in. Select **Submit** to sign in again.
error.login_denied: The sign-in was declined. Select **Submit** to try again.
error.login_expired: The code expired before it was approved. Select **Submit** to get a new one.
error.plan_limit: Your Thalovant plan already uses all of its connections. Remove one in the Thalovant dashboard, then try again.
error.public_hubs_only: Your Thalovant plan links Home Assistant to public hubs only. Choose a public hub, or upgrade your plan to use your own.

abort.all_hubs_linked: Every hub on this Thalovant account is already linked to this Home Assistant.
abort.already_configured: This hub is already linked to Home Assistant.
abort.already_in_progress: A link to this hub is already being set up.
abort.hub_not_found: This hub is no longer available to your Thalovant account.
abort.no_hubs: This Thalovant account has no hub that Home Assistant can be linked to.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Thalovant account. Sign in with the account this link belongs to.

data_description.agent_id: The agent that answers requests from the hub. Home Assistant's own agent only acts on entities exposed to Assist.

error.agent_not_found: This conversation agent is not available.

auth_failed.message: The hub {hub} rejected this connection's credentials

credentials_invalid.message: The stored credentials for {hub} cannot be read

agent_unavailable.title: The conversation agent for {hub} is gone
agent_unavailable.description: Requests from {hub} go to the conversation agent `{agent}`, which Home Assistant cannot find any more. Until you choose another agent in the Thalovant integration's options, the hub gets an error for everything it asks.

common.reply_failed_to_handle: Sorry, Home Assistant couldn't do that.
common.reply_no_intent_match: Sorry, Home Assistant didn't understand that.
common.reply_no_valid_targets: Sorry, Home Assistant couldn't find that device.
common.reply_timeout: Sorry, Home Assistant took too long to answer.
common.reply_unknown: Sorry, something went wrong in Home Assistant.
